title: Moon Chat Owner & Public-Source Contribution Schema (Phase 2.7.8)
description: Schema accepted by `python -m datasets.chat.contribute --import <file>`. All imported records default strictly to `PENDING_REVIEW` and require explicit reviewer verification via `python -m datasets.chat.review_queue --approve` before entering production manifests.

id.description: Optional unique record identifier. Auto-generated deterministically if omitted.

attribution.description: Explicit author or contributor attribution text (e.g., 'Prem Gaikwad (Moon AI Chief ML Systems Architect)').

transformation_performed.description: Required when summarizing a public source: explains how permitted source material was rewritten/adapted into an original educational example.

prompt.description: Shorthand single-turn user question (used if `messages` is omitted).

answer.description: Shorthand single-turn assistant explanation (used if `messages` is omitted).
